representation_plans.learner_operation: Relate heads, tails, core, proteins, and cholesterol to function.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Describe extracellular water, heads, tails, core, embedded proteins, cholesterol, and intracellular water in order.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Mark permeability and downhill direction for solute or water.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List each side’s concentrations, membrane permeability, and moving species without supplying direction.
State temperature and particle concentrations for each solution without ranking pressure.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Track energy, ion gradient, charge sign, movement, and voltage direction.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State inside/outside concentration, charge, channel or pump state, energy use, and initial potential without predicting movement.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Match detect, traffic, communicate, seal, and anchor functions to structures.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Describe ligand binding, vesicle direction, direct channel, paracellular seal, and mechanical attachment as separate labeled cases.

demand_inventory.description: Explain selective containment from amphipathic bilayer organization.
Distinguish phospholipid, protein, cholesterol, and wax roles.
Explain lateral motion and qualitative cholesterol fluidity buffering.
Distinguish simple and facilitated downhill transport from active transport.
Use membrane permeability before predicting persistent gradients.
Predict water movement toward greater effective nonpenetrating solute.
Relate particle concentration to ideal osmotic pressure.
Identify direct energy use for uphill ion movement and gradient maintenance.
Predict passive channel movement down electrochemical gradients.
Combine chemical and electrical drives qualitatively.
Translate net charge movement into depolarization or hyperpolarization.
Explain surface signal detection and intracellular response.
Distinguish endocytosis inward from exocytosis outward.
Distinguish direct communication, paracellular sealing, and mechanical adhesion.

changed_task_decision_points.decision_point: Near asks for containment material; changed asks for a cholesterol-mediated dynamic effect, so the selected component must change.
Near predicts water direction; changed compares osmotic pressure from particle count, requiring a pressure relation rather than a direction alone.
near_trace: Move water toward greater effective concentration.

changed_task_decision_points.decision_point: Near classifies energy-driven uphill transport; changed converts passive charge movement into voltage direction.
Near selects surface signal detection; changed selects a paracellular seal, requiring a junction function rather than receptor logic.
changed_trace: Distinguish seal from pore and anchor.
